name: Dry Foam

features.text: Specially formulated not to saturate fabric and carpets.
Reduces dry-time and speeds the cleaning process.
Contains color brighteners to bring back faded colors.

description: A thick, amber solution with a pleasant, fresh fragrance. It is designed to produce a high foam that captures dirt and suspends it, prohibiting it from reentering the carpet and upholstery.
application: Dilution ratio with water: Regular Use: 1 part to 32 parts water (4 oz. per gallon of water). Heavy Use: 1 part to 20 parts water (6 oz. per gallon of water). Scoop diluted foam onto carpet and agitate. Brush in a single direction with a pile brush. Wipe with clean, dry towel. When carpet is dry, vacuum well.
